purpose: professional/business work-email resolution + passive verification for one bounded A-Plus recipient (Greg Yamin, President), M6.9 Path B pilot

counsel_source_authorization.scope: specific to Hunter for the currently authorized M6.10 contact-enrichment use; does not authorize other providers; no broader legal conclusion inferred

lawful_sourcing_warranty.basis: Hunter published privacy policy / GDPR-compliance docs: data crawled only from publicly-accessible business web pages; no private inboxes, personal social profiles, or non-public sources. Public product representation, not a negotiated warranty.

per_record_provenance.basis: Hunter Email Finder API returns a per-result `sources` array of URLs.

no_sensitive_categories.basis: business email addresses only; no special-category data in scope.

no_minors.basis: B2B professional email finding; no minor data in scope.

no_scraped_credentials.basis: finds published email addresses, not credentials.

deletion_on_request.basis: public claim/removal process at hunter.io/claim; privacy@hunter.io for signed DPA; profiles auto-removed within ~3 months once off source pages.

vendor_contractual_controls_or_indemnity.basis: DPA included in Hunter Terms of Use at signup (GDPR Art. 28); signed version on request. Indemnity is NOT part of the standard clickthrough agreement - recorded explicitly; the field is satisfied on the contractual-controls (DPA) limb.

texas_data_broker_registry_screened.basis: PROJECT_OWNER supplied Texas counsel's exact operational decision closing the previously-blocked screening gate. The counsel-supplied decision is accepted per the authorization's own instruction ('do not create a new blocker merely because the registry evidence is counsel-supplied rather than independently scraped').
